fonts.title: Data sources and reuse
fonts.intro: Here you can see where the data comes from and under which conditions we reuse it.
fonts.independence: Tens pla? is an independent project: it is not an official service of the Generalitat de Catalunya or Ticketmaster. Data may change at the source; prices, availability and tickets depend on the original providers.
fonts.ticketmaster: The Ticketmaster Discovery Feed/API is not Open Data. It is used in accordance with its terms, none of its images are reused and ticket links lead to the external provider. Ticketmaster is not yet enabled in production.
fonts.fever: Fever booking links are affiliate links. Tens pla? may receive a commission at no extra cost to you; this does not alter the order of the plans. Images remain disabled by default.
fonts.icgc: Geography derived from Administrative divisions, snapshot of 20/01/2026, CC BY 4.0. Modifications: EPSG:4326, field and bbox selection, deterministic ordering and rounding to 6 decimals.
fonts.corrections: To report a correction or request a removal, write to contacte@tenspla.cat.

seo.widgetTitle: Plans agenda for your website | Tens pla?
seo.widgetDescription: Add a Tens pla? plans agenda, with official data that is always up to date, to the website of your municipality, tourist office or accommodation.
widget.title: The Tens pla? agenda on your website
widget.intro: Show your visitors what they can do in the area: festivals, concerts, theatre, fairs, visits and museums. An agenda that updates itself from official sources and fits into any website with two lines of code.
widget.demoIntro: Two examples with real data from today. Pick the format you like best: each agenda is set up for your area and your style.
widget.demoCaption.list: Plans for a whole comarca, el Bages, in list format.
widget.demoCaption.grid: Plans within 15 km of Pals, in grid format, with a tab of places to visit.
widget.demoNote: Links open the plan page on Tens pla?.
widget.steps.write.title: You write to us
widget.steps.write.body: Tell us which website you have, which area you want to show and what kind of plans interest you.
widget.steps.setup.title: We set up your agenda
widget.steps.setup.body: We configure it for the area you want (a municipality, a comarca, a province or a radius in km around a point), with the categories, format, language and colours you choose.
widget.steps.paste.title: You paste two lines
widget.steps.paste.body: We give you a code to insert in your website. From then on the agenda updates itself.
widget.features.sources: Plans from official sources, the Agenda Cultural de Catalunya and the Diputació de Barcelona, without duplicates.
widget.features.territory: You choose the area: a municipality, a comarca, a province or the plans a few km from a point, such as a hotel or a campsite.
widget.features.look: List, grid or compact format, in the colour of your website.
widget.features.languages: In Catalan, Spanish and English. Plan listings appear in their original language, mostly Catalan.
widget.features.fresh: It updates several times a day, without you having to do anything.
widget.features.privacy: It installs no cookies and does not track the visitors of your website.
widget.features.domains: It only works on the domains you tell us.
widget.codeIntro: This is all you need to paste into the page where you want the agenda. We give you the key.
widget.ctaTitle: Want the agenda on your website?
widget.ctaBody: Write to us and tell us about your website, the area and the kind of plans you want to show. We will reply with a proposal.
widget.mailSubject: Tens pla? agenda for my website
